name: IBY_FNDCPT_SYS_DC_PF_B
description: IBY_FNDCPT_SYS_DC_PF stores payment system-defined attributes of the bank account electronic funds transfer process.

columns.name: SYS_DC_PROFILE_CODE
columns.description: System process profile identifier

columns.name: PAYMENT_SYSTEM_ID
columns.description: Payment system identifier

columns.name: ONLINE_DEB_FORMAT_CODE
columns.description: Payment format identifier for online debits

columns.name: ONLINE_DEB_TRANS_PRTCL_CODE
columns.description: Transmission protocol for online debit messages

columns.name: ONLINE_DEB_ACK_RDR_CODE
columns.description: Acknowledgment reader for debit responses

columns.name: SETTLEMENT_REQ_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether settlement is required by the payment system after the online debit

columns.name: SETTLEMENT_FORMAT_CODE
columns.description: Format for settlements

columns.name: SETTLEMENT_TRANS_PRTCL_CODE
columns.description: Transmission protocol for funds transfer messages

columns.name: SETTLEMENT_ACK_RDR_CODE
columns.description: Acknowledgment reader for funds transfer responses

columns.name: QUERY_FORMAT_CODE
columns.description: Format for the query request

columns.name: QUERY_TRANS_PRTCL_CODE
columns.description: Transmission protocol for query requests

columns.name: QUERY_ACK_RDR_CODE
columns.description: Query acknowledgment or response reader

columns.name: INACTIVE_DATE
columns.description: Inactivity date for the profile

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: GROUP_BY_ORG
columns.description: Y or N flag specifying whether settlements should be grouped into settlement batches by first party organization

columns.name: GROUP_BY_LEGAL_ENTITY
columns.description: Y or N flag specifying whether settlements should be grouped into settlement batches by first party legal entity

columns.name: GROUP_BY_INT_BANK_ACCOUNT
columns.description: Y or N flag specifying whether settlements should be grouped into settlement batches by internal bank account

columns.name: GROUP_BY_SETTLEMENT_CURR
columns.description: Y or N flag specifying whether settlements should be grouped into settlement batches by settlement currency

columns.name: GROUP_BY_SETTLEMENT_DATE
columns.description: Y or N flag specifying whether settlements should be grouped into settlement batches by settlement date

columns.name: LIMIT_BY_AMT_CURR
columns.description: Currency in which the maximum total amount per settlement batch is calculated.

columns.name: LIMIT_BY_EXCH_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Exchange rate type, such as corporate, spot, and daily, used to compare the settlement batch total amount to the maximum total amount allowed. Types are defined in the General Ledger currency exchange rate type table.

columns.name: LIMIT_BY_TOTAL_AMT
columns.description: Maximum total amount for which a settlement batch can be created

columns.name: LIMIT_BY_SETTLEMENT_NUM
columns.description: Maximum number of settlements that can be included in a settlement batch

columns.name: SETTLEMENT_COMPLETE_POINT
columns.description: A point when the settlement is considered complete.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_PAYER_DELIVERY_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N Flag indicating whether the payer notification delivery method should be overridden by the payer delivery method preference.

columns.name: PAYER_NOTIFICATION_FORMAT
columns.description: Payment format identifier for payer notification

columns.name: PAYER_NOTIFICATION_DEL_METHOD
columns.description: Remittance advice delivery method. Values, from the lookup IBY_DELIVERY_METHODS, include EMAIL, FAX, and PRINTED

columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.
